items.question: Which additional female figures complete the ongoing enumeration of those who know through devotion?
premises: The verse continues a list begun in the preceding context.
The named figures are ulukī, pecakī, sararī, and gūlī.
Disjunctive and additive particles link these figures within the enumeration.
items.inference: The enumeration is extended to include the owl-woman, peacock-woman, sarari-woman, and guli-woman as further figures in the same series.
uncertainties: The precise identity or symbolic meaning of sararī and gūlī is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Likewise, the owl-woman, or indeed the peacock-woman, or the sarari-woman, or the guli-woman.
